basics.name: Acevedo Miguel Angel
basics.label: Cloud Architect & DevOps Engineer
basics.summary: Cloud Architect and DevOps Engineer with 20+ years of experience designing serverless, high-availability infrastructure across APAC. Proven track record leading distributed technical teams and delivering IoT solutions for the Japan energy market. Deep expertise in AWS serverless architectures (Lambda, EKS), Kubernetes, and AWS IoT Core. Based in Hong Kong (GMT+8) with extensive experience collaborating with teams across Singapore, US, Europe, and Japan. Fluent in English and Spanish; basic Japanese (JLPT N5).

work.name: Tensor Energy
highlights: Architected the next-generation energy platform for the Japan market, defining the serverless base architecture and tech stack
Led distributed technical teams across APAC, establishing development and deployment standards for the energy platform
Built serverless backend services in TypeScript (GraphQL) and Go (Lambda) on PostgreSQL (Aurora), with protobuf / gRPC contracts, Step Functions, ECS, and Batch
Optimized infrastructure costs by adopting AWS serverless and EKS architectures
Automated infrastructure provisioning and management with AWS CDK

work.name: Henderson (China) Investment Company Limited
highlights: Architected high-availability systems for China and Hong Kong, driving performance optimization and cost-efficient library selection
Designed streaming microservice architecture for IoT integration on PostgreSQL with protobuf / gRPC, including AWS IoT Core device provisioning and management
Owned CI/CD strategy and DevOps best practices, reducing deployment risk across mainland China and Hong Kong
Integrated IoT hardware with third-party providers to support large-scale device fleets
Deployed and managed Kubernetes platforms on AWS (EKS and bare-metal EC2)
Maintained observability stack (Grafana, Kibana, Elasticsearch, Filebeat), storage (Redis, PostgreSQL, Cassandra), and messaging (Kafka, MQTT)

work.name: Cereb Intelligence
highlights: Cut deployment cycles by ~40% and eliminated recurring build errors by migrating to Docker-based build and release processes
Planned scalable, highly available AWS infrastructure using EKS, Kafka, and Node.js to support IoT services
Developed backend services on PostgreSQL with protobuf / gRPC, integrating third-party APIs (Lifesmart, Softhard.io, Salto Access, SMS gateway, Dingtalk, Telegram Bot, Slack Bot)
Built monitoring and reporting dashboards to improve infrastructure observability
Reduced CI/CD spend and improved pipeline speed by migrating from Bitbucket Pipelines to self-hosted Jenkins
Provided remote support for 1,000+ connected devices across APAC

Reviewed third-party STM32 C/C++ firmware for connected-device integration

Worked with cross-functional teams, the CTO, and the CEO to translate business needs into product and engineering priorities
